source: JAO Publication Tool, Italy North CCR & IBWT (publicationtool.jao.eu/ibwt)
description: Price spreads, neighbour minus Italy, EUR/MWh: Austria, France and Slovenia against Italy North (NORD), Greece against Italy South (SUD); day-ahead market and intraday auctions IDA 1-3. Hourly = average of the quarter-hours; daily = average of the hours. Italian market time (Europe/Rome), labelled by elapsed time since local midnight. Quarter-hourly series start at quarter_hourly_native_from (per market); earlier quarter-hours repeat the hourly value. income: congestion income, EUR per hour, exports from Italy (IT->X) above zero and imports into Italy (X->IT) below; daily = the day's total; quarter-hourly from income_quarter_hourly_from.
